reference: Valid complete hexadecimal byte streams are compared against xxd plain mode. Separate contracts cover the documented optional leading 0x prefix and strict rejection of malformed input; xxd intentionally tolerates malformed input and is not an error-path oracle.
coverage: Bash metadata: `type -t` reports binhex as a builtin and `help binhex` contains the documented description.
Encode empty input, mixed binary stdin containing NUL and high-bit bytes, a relative file argument, and 4097 deterministic bytes across the implementation's 4096-byte read boundary.
Decode compact hex, whitespace-separated hex, and a relative hex-file argument, preserving arbitrary output bytes.
Separate strict malformed-input contracts and permissive xxd compatibility differences; no full decoder equivalence claim.
exclusions: Deterministically injecting EINTR and short read/write results requires syscall fault injection and is listed as deferred.
No privilege, device, terminal, network, or host-path operation is part of binhex.
Full xxd decoding compatibility is not claimed: binhex rejects nonhex characters and incomplete bytes.

cases.purpose: Check Bash reports binhex as a builtin and its help text contains the documented description.
Empty stdin encodes to zero hex bytes with no newline.
cases.script:
if [[ $(type -t binhex) == builtin ]]; then
printf '' | binhex
else
printf '' | xxd -p -c 999999 | /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import sys; d=sys.stdin.buffer.read(); assert not d or d.endswith(b'"'"'\n'"'"'); sys.stdout.buffer.write(d[:-1] if d else d)'
fi

cases.purpose: Encode NUL, control, high-bit, and printable bytes from stdin as lowercase hex.
cases.script:
if [[ $(type -t binhex) == builtin ]]; then
printf '\000\001\012\015\177\200\377A\n' | binhex
else
printf '\000\001\012\015\177\200\377A\n' | xxd -p -c 999999 | /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import sys; d=sys.stdin.buffer.read(); assert not d or d.endswith(b'"'"'\n'"'"'); sys.stdout.buffer.write(d[:-1] if d else d)'
fi

cases.purpose: Encode bytes read from one relative FILE argument, including an embedded NUL.
cases.script:
printf 'Bash\nbinary\000tail' > sample.bin
if [[ $(type -t binhex) == builtin ]]; then
binhex sample.bin
else
xxd -p -c 999999 sample.bin | /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import sys; d=sys.stdin.buffer.read(); assert not d or d.endswith(b'"'"'\n'"'"'); sys.stdout.buffer.write(d[:-1] if d else d)'
fi

cases.purpose: Encode 4097 deterministic bytes to cover a read crossing the implementation's 4096-byte buffer boundary.
cases.script:
printf '%4097s' '' > boundary.bin
if [[ $(type -t binhex) == builtin ]]; then
binhex boundary.bin
else
xxd -p -c 999999 boundary.bin | /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import sys; d=sys.stdin.buffer.read(); assert not d or d.endswith(b'"'"'\n'"'"'); sys.stdout.buffer.write(d[:-1] if d else d)'
fi

cases.purpose: Decode compact uppercase and lowercase hex into NUL, newline, printable, and high-bit bytes.
cases.script:
if [[ $(type -t binhex) != builtin ]]; then
  printf '000a41b2ff\n' | xxd -r -p
else
  printf '000a41b2ff\n' | binhex -d
fi

cases.purpose: Decode plain hex containing spaces, a tab, and a line break between byte pairs.
cases.script:
if [[ $(type -t binhex) != builtin ]]; then
  printf '00 41\nFF\t42\n' | xxd -r -p
else
  printf '00 41\nFF\t42\n' | binhex -d
fi

cases.purpose: Decode a whitespace-formatted relative FILE argument and preserve binary output.
cases.script:
printf '0a 00 5a ff\n' > encoded.txt
if [[ $(type -t binhex) != builtin ]]; then
  xxd -r -p encoded.txt
else
  binhex -d encoded.txt
fi

cases.reason: A future disposable VM or audited syscall mock must wrap only fixture file descriptors and inject EINTR plus short reads/writes. The provided harness has no deterministic syscall-injection fixture, and ordinary files/pipes cannot reliably force these return patterns.
